# sherpa-layout-canvas

An infinite canvas content area: it pans and zooms with no edge, on a crosshair grid. Will, TODO 25. TRAP T-a-canvas-owns-its-view

## When to use it

For content that pans and zooms with no edge, each item placed at its `--x` and `--y`; the canvas owns its view and reports each move. For content placed on the layout grid's columns, use `sherpa-layout-grid`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-layout-canvas style="inline-size: 640px; block-size: 360px"><sherpa-callout slot="banner" data-type="banner" data-status="info" data-dismissible>A new version is ready.</sherpa-callout><div style="--x: 40px; --y: 120px">A card on the canvas</div></sherpa-layout-canvas>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-editing` | boolean |  | an edit mode: the panels and the toolbar hide, and the footer shows along the bottom; the view, the minimap and the controls stay |
| `data-max-zoom` | number | `4` | the largest zoom |
| `data-min-zoom` | number | `0.25` | the smallest zoom ; less where the content needs it, so all of it can be in view |
| `data-no-minimap` | boolean |  | no minimap |
| `data-panel-end-width` | number |  |  |
| `data-panel-start-width` | number |  |  |
| `data-select-box` | boolean |  | a plain left drag on blank canvas draws a box and reports it (canvas-box) instead of panning; Space + drag, the middle button and the Pan tool still pan data-panel-start-width, data-panel-end-width a card area's width, in px: what a reader dragged its edge to, handed back by the host. Never under 16rem nor over 60% of the canvas |
| `data-zoom` | number |  | the zoom, 1 is 100%; written BY the canvas as it zooms, and read when a host sets it |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view` | `{ x: number; y: number; zoom: number }` | read only |  |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `panTo(x: number, y: number)` | Move the plane origin to (x, y) in the view, in screen px. |
| `zoomTo(zoom: number, cx?: number, cy?: number)` | Zoom to `zoom`, keeping the point at (cx, cy) in the view where it is — the view's middle unless given. |
| `zoomBy(factor: number)` | Zoom by a factor, about the middle of what the view shows. |
| `fit()` | Fit every piece of content in what the view shows, beside the card; no nearer than 100%. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `canvas-change` | `{ x: number; y: number; zoom: number }` | The view moved: panned or zoomed. |
| `panel-area-resize` | `{ side: 'end' \| 'start'; width: number }` | The panel's area was resized by its edge, dragged or by the keys. |
| `panel-dock` | `{ place: 'bottom' \| 'only' \| 'top'; side: 'end' \| 'start' }` | A floating card was dropped on a lit area and docked there. |
| `canvas-box` | `{ bottom: number; left: number; mode: BoxMode; right: number; top: number }` | A box was dragged on blank canvas. |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `panel-start` | panel |  |
| `panel-end` | panel |  |
| `panel-float` | panel | the floating cards, off their areas: they float in the canvas |
| `banner` | content | notices FLOATING across the top, 32px in, beside the panel: they do not pan or zoom; two shown stack, and a hidden one takes no room (a reload banner) |
| `rows` | item | a strip of ROWS behind the view, the whole width: each stands at its `--y` down the plane, `--height` tall (plane px); it pans and zooms down, never across. |
| `columns` | item | a strip of COLUMNS over the view, from its top: each stands at its `--x` across the plane, `--width` wide (plane px, as `--x` and `--y` are); it pans and zooms across, never down. |
| (default) | content | the content, placed on the canvas at its `--x` and `--y` (px) |
| `toolbar` | toolbar | tools FLOATING at the bottom centre, 16px up (level with the zoom controls), beside the panel: they do not pan or zoom (a node toolbar) |
| `footer` | footer | the edit mode's footer, along the canvas's bottom edge: shown only with `data-editing` (Save and Cancel) |
| `columns-end` | control | controls at the END of the columns' head: the top right of what the view shows, clear of a panel's tabs (Add stage, Arrange stages) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`banner`, `columns`, `columns-end`, `controls`, `footer`, `inset`, `marquee`, `minimap`, `panels`, `plane`, `rows`, `stage`, `toolbar`, `viewport`
